title: MegaGen Partners With USC Ostrow School of Dentistry
html:
MegaGen Implant, a global dental implant specialist, announced today that it has established a new philanthropic partnership with the Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry at the University of Southern California (USC). MegaGen is the first Korean implant company to support a U.S. dental school’s implant clinical education and research.

This investment connects MegaGen with one of the major dental education institutions in the United States. In particular, the partnership will expand MegaGen’s global clinical education and research collaborations into North America, contributing to the development of future clinical specialists and the advancement of implant dentistry education.

Strengthening Clinical Education, Research Collaboration, and Academic Exchange in Implant Dentistry

MegaGen’s gift will strengthen clinical education and academic exchange in implant dentistry and periodontology through the establishment of a named professorship and the provision of supplies and equipment for USC Ostrow programs and students. It will expand opportunities for cooperation across various areas, including education and mentoring for dental school students and dental specialists, as well as clinical and research collaboration.

This generosity also lays a foundation for connecting MegaGen’s accumulated implant technology expertise and global clinical experience with USC’s academic and educational infrastructure. Through this integration, the two institutions aim to create a collaborative environment in which practical clinical experience and academic research can mutually advance and develop.

Expanding the Global Academic Network into North America

MegaGen has built its brand credibility in the global market not only through product competitiveness but also through an emphasis on scientific evidence and clinical education.

In Europe, MegaGen has strengthened its capabilities in quality assurance and regulatory compliance in response to the CE MDR (Medical Device Regulation). At the same time, through MINEC (MegaGen International Network of Education & Clinical Research), it has developed clinical education networks in collaboration with major research centers and academic institutions in European countries, including Sweden, Greece, and Portugal.

MegaGen is also continuing to expand regional academic exchange and support educational infrastructure through partnerships with major dental institutions around the world. These include Seoul National University Graduate School of Dentistry and Kyungpook National University School of Dentistry in South Korea, Future University in Egypt, and Universiti Malaya in Malaysia.

About MegaGen Implant

The MegaGen brand is now recognized as a world leader in dental implants. Our innovative products and solutions are acknowledged as game changers for more successful implant treatments and as a new standard for dental implants and digital dentistry.

Founded by dentists and driven by dentists, we are continually working toward lifetime smiles. We develop technology to realize dreams and design the future of health care, working ethically and in good faith to become a total health care innovator.
